title: The motel application
logline: A uniform polo on a hanger for four panels. Wood in it in the fifth — there is no fifth. He's in it in the fourth.

panels.composition: The garage. A maroon polo shirt on a hanger, hooked on the drafting lamp. Embroidered: DRIFTWOOD MOTEL. WOOD looking at it. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a maroon polo shirt on a hanger hooked over a green swing-arm lamp in a garage studio, a small embroidered motel logo on its chest, a man looking at it, an old dog, muddy watercolor

panels.composition: The polo. Wood, from the other side of the table. Still looking.

balloons.text: Night audit. Eleven to seven. They said I'd 'have time to draw.' They said it like a threat.

image.prompt: a man looking at a hanging polo shirt from across a drafting table

panels.composition: The polo. The dog looking at it too.

image.prompt: an old dog looking up at a maroon polo shirt on a hanger, no words

panels.composition: Wood in the polo. It's a size too big. The lamp. The dog. 10:40 PM by the clock. He's already drawing tomorrow's strip before the first shift.

image.prompt: a thin man wearing a maroon motel polo a size too big sitting at a drafting table drawing before his first night shift, a clock reading 10:40, an old dog nearby

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The polo. Night audit. 'Time to draw,' said like a threat.
